annotations.text:
Four shells for the same 421 records, all built on the tokens already in globals.css.

They differ on what LEADS: A navigation · B triage · C status · D the data itself.
Pick one and it gets built into the app — the others can stay as reference.

A — Navigation leads.
Saved views replace the filter bar. Best when you keep asking the same five questions.
Cost: the rail eats 236px, and views need managing.

B — Triage leads.
List and detail side by side; you never navigate away. Best for working a backlog down.
Cost: only ~4 columns fit, so it is poor for scanning.

C — Status leads.
The phase model becomes the layout; drag a card to change status.
Cost: stops working past a few hundred records. A view, not the home screen.

D — The data leads.
Still a sheet, just a good one: 27 rows on screen, inline edit, folding groups, stats inline.
Cost: looks least designed, and leans on keyboard use.
